summary: PHASE 46 (phone-keyed parent invites) — tested backend via unit pytest (test_phase46.py 6/6 passing) and new live API suite (test_phase46_live.py 7/7 passing against the deployed backend). Verified: ready-to-invite listing, bulk invite bucketing (invited/already_linked/skipped_no_phone/collisions_for_review), idempotent rerun → already_linked with no new stub messages, phone normalization dedupe (+91 99900 46002 == 9990046002), setup-code 6-digit + hashed storage, review bucket GET/resolve dismiss, bad-id single invite 4xx, tampered /setup/parent/<token> API 4xx, wrong-code public parent-register 4xx. UI smoke on /app/students confirmed invite-parents-open-btn + dialog + invite-scope-all + invite-channel-select + invite-run-btn render; /setup/parent/<bad-token> shows parent-setup-error; /setup/parent paper register renders register-admission-no/code/submit. All TEST_P46_ students and 99900460xx parent users/messages/invites cleaned up. Acceptance accounts 9847010001/2/3 untouched.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~10,991 lines — well past the recommended split threshold. Phase 46 adds ~310 lines in one place; consider extracting parent_invites router into /app/backend/routes/parent_invites.py for maintainability.

The setup-code response (POST /api/students/{id}/setup-code) returns the plaintext 6-digit code for printing; the DB stores it hashed (verified). Good — but there is no visible rate-limit on this endpoint beyond admin auth; consider throttling to prevent code-print abuse.
parent_setup_codes documents are not auto-expired via Mongo TTL — long-lived unused codes accumulate. Consider a TTL index on created_at or an explicit expires_at field with a TTL index.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted throwaway TEST_P46_* students in Grade 7 A using phones 9990046001/9990046002/9990046010 — fully cleaned via pre+post module fixture that purges students, synthetic parent users (p999004600x@lpgs.parent.invite), parent_invites, parent_setup_codes and messages (recipient_phone ^99900460).
context_for_next_testing_agent: /app/backend/tests/test_phase46_live.py is a self-cleaning live suite — safe to re-run (uses TEST_P46_ prefix + 99900460xx phones; wipes before and after). Keep acceptance phones 9847010001/002/003 as-is; brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login — do not retry wrong passwords. Comm is STUB mode; messages collection field is recipient_phone (not 'to').
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found in Phase 46 scope.
